notes.title: Devlog #6 | We're Back in the Garage! 🔧
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]It’s been a long road — and not the smoothest one.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44801849/ee2b6b73d524386d5b3a063483a70c51400a18a1.png"][/img][/p][p]After a long break, we’re finally back. Honestly, we had to step away for a while due to some pretty tough times. We lost our entire team and, for a moment, it felt like maybe the project wouldn't survive.[/p][p][/p][p]But… we didn’t give up.[/p][p]Right now, we’re just two people building this game — doing everything we can to bring it to life. We've been quietly working on a new [b]vertical slice[/b], and we’re finally starting to see the game take shape in a way we’re really proud of.[/p][p]We know there’s been criticism. Some of it stung, but it also helped us a lot. We’ve taken everything to heart and built a [b]stronger core loop[/b] that feels genuinely fun. And honestly? The game is going great.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Welcome to the Garage[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44801849/e5ce83eea532b72c67b3e50f0c090ae2e2df89e4.gif"][/img][/p][p]In this devlog, we wanted to give you a peek into the [b]garage gameplay[/b], which has become a big part of the game’s soul.[/p][p]You can now:[/p][list][*][p][b]Wash, clean off rust, and repair old vans[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Paint them with spray guns[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decorate the interiors however you like[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Slap on stickers you find during your adventures[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Right now, you can place furniture freely, wherever you want — but we’re also working on an optional [b]grid system[/b] to help with more precise building for those who want a bit more structure.[/p][p]We’re intentionally giving players [b]full creative control[/b]. We want everyone to build their dream vans, no matter how wild or cozy or chaotic.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be posting devlogs [b]regularly[/b] from now on to keep you in the loop. A [b]Discord server[/b] is also on the way — we’d love to build this game alongside you, with your feedback and ideas.[/p][p]Thanks for sticking around. We’re just getting started again, and it means the world to us that you’re here.[/p][p][/p][p]PS: Yeah we know that black paint is coming from red spray, it was just for testing. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 📢 We’re Back & We Have a F2P Mobile Release! 🚐
notes.notes:
📢 [b]We’re Back & We Have a Mobile Release![/b] 🚐

Hey everyone,

First of all, we want to apologize for our long silence. Due to a serious health issue and financial challenges, we had to pause development for quite some time.

But now, we’re back—stronger than ever! 💪 We’ve made some [b]changes to the core systems, improved optimization, and even refreshed our visual style[/b]—it’s looking better than ever, and we’re sure you’ll love it!

Your support during this tough period meant the world to us. It kept us going, and we truly believe this break will lead to an even better and more polished game for you all to enjoy.

🔥 Exciting news! [b]We just launched a free-to-play mobile version (demo) of VanLife Simulator![/b] It’s still in development, but we’d love for you to try it and share your feedback so we can create the best experience on both platforms.

👉 Try it here:
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.CrossBone.VanLifeSimulator]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.CrossBone.VanLifeSimulator[/url]

[b]The PC version will be deeper and more feature-rich than the mobile version, so stay tuned for updates![/b]

Thank you all for your patience and support. 🚐✨ More news coming soon!

notes.title: Devlog #5: Navigate Efficiently - Introducing the Mini-Map! 🗺️
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers! 

We're excited to introduce the latest feature in "VanLife Simulator" that will make your journeys smoother: the mini-map! Here's what to expect with this handy update: 

1. Find Your Way Easily 

Never lose your way again with our new mini-map! Whether you're exploring cities or countryside, it offers a clear view of your surroundings, ensuring you always know where you are. 

2. Discover New Places 

Explore nearby venues and attractions effortlessly with the mini-map. From cozy cafes to scenic campsites, it highlights interesting spots around you, inviting you to explore and enjoy new adventures. 

3. Quest Tracking Made Simple 

Keep track of your quests and missions with ease. The mini-map displays quest markers and waypoints, guiding you to your next destination and ensuring you never miss an opportunity for adventure. 

4. Customize for Your Comfort 

Personalize the mini-map to suit your preferences. Adjust zoom levels, toggle different map layers, and choose display options that work best for you, making navigation a breeze. 

5. Share Your Journey 

We would love to hear your feedback on the new minimap! Share your stories with us as we continue to develop "VanLife Simulator" together.  

Stay tuned for more exciting updates in future devlogs.   

Happy travels! 

CrossBone☠️

notes.title: Devlog#4: Mastering Survival
notes.notes:
1. Establish Your Haven ⛺

Venture into the wild and create your shelter. Choose a campsite wisely, crafting a temporary haven uniquely yours in the vastness of nature. 

  

2. Ignite the Flame 🔥

Survival goes beyond warmth. Master the art of making fire – a skill transforming cold nights into cozy adventures. Gather resources, ignite the flame, and let the warmth accompany your van life journey. 

  

3. Satisfy the Basics 🚰🍽️🏃

Feel the pulse of survival. Manage hydration and nutrition strategically, ensuring water and food for the journey. Discover hidden water sources, purify your finds, and forage for edible plants. Stamina becomes crucial for exploration - manage your energy wisely to face challenges. 

  

4. Combat Starvation 🍔⚔️

Survival fuels the hunger for adventure. Manage food supplies, forage, and try your luck at fishing. Conquer starvation with smart planning and resourcefulness in the van life landscape. 

  

5. Dynamic Survival  🌦️🔄🌍

Survival is a dynamic dance with nature. Adapt to changing weather, evolving landscapes, and unforeseen challenges. Your decisions shape your survival story in this immersive van life simulator. 

 

Happy Travelling 🚐

Crossbone ☠️

notes.title: Devlog#3: The Inventory System
notes.notes:
1. Backpack Basics🎒  

  

Keep your essentials handy, people! Pack your essentials in your trusty rucksack. Remember, safety is tight - keep your valuables close by! 

  

2. Refrigerator Renovation❄️  

  

Introducing the newest addition to your van - the fridge! No more lukewarm drinks or spoilt snacks. Slide these goodies into the fridge for a fresh and cold treat on the go. It's not just about convenience; it's about outdoor survival! 

  

3. Equipment on the Go 🚐 

  

Going on an adventure? Pack smart, VanLifers! Choose your belongings carefully and fill your rucksack before you set off. Every item counts, especially when you're out exploring the world. Be prepared for everything from scenic views to unexpected challenges. 

  

4. Safety Precautions🔒 

  

In a world full of uncertainty, security is paramount. Keep your valuables close and keep an eye out for potential threats. With the risk of theft looming, it's important to stay vigilant and protect your valuables. Your van is your home - protect it with everything you have! 

 

Stay tuned for more devlogs as we continue enhancing your VanLife. Whether you're gearing up for a trip or safeguarding against potential theft  the road beckons, and so does the adventure! 🌟 

 

Happy travels, 

CrossBone ️☠️

notes.title: Devlog#2: Dancing with the Elements - Weather Update! ☔🌤️
notes.notes:
Hello, VanLifers! We're back with exciting news in Devlog#2 and this time we jump into the heart of our game's atmosphere - the weather! 🚐☔❄️ 

1. Dynamic Weather Unleashed 

Get ready for a game-changing experience as we introduce dynamic weather mechanics. Raindrops dancing on your windshield, snowflakes gently covering your van, and the warmth of a sunny day – nature's mood swings are now an integral part of your VanLife journey. 

2. Rain or Shine, Choose Your Path 

Each weather condition brings its own challenges and delights. Maneuver through rainy landscapes with caution, navigate icy roads in the snow, or bask in the sunny serenity. The choice is yours, and the adventure adapts to every twist and turn of the weather. 

3. A Visual Feast: Weather Effects 

Immerse yourself in the visual feast of our weather effects. Watch as raindrops create ripples on puddles, snow blankets the ground, and sunlight plays through the trees. The world around you comes alive, adding a new layer of realism to your VanLife experience. 

4. Your Feedback Matters 

As always, your feedback is invaluable. How does the weather impact your VanLife? Share your thoughts, suggestions, and stories with us. Together, we're crafting an immersive and ever-evolving VanLife simulator. 

Stay tuned for more devlogs as we continue to improve your minibus living experience. Rain, shine or snow - the road awaits you! 🌟 

Happy adventuring, CrossBone

notes.title: New Customization Features!
notes.notes:
Hey there fellow VanLifers;  

 

Today, we're super excited to chat about a cool feature in our upcoming game - the power to customize your van and make it truly yours! 🚐 

 

1.Your Van,Your Style  

Discover a game-changing van life experience with our latest enhancements! Your van, now fully customizable, is more than just a vehicle—it's an expression of you. Personalize it with unique paint, decals, and other options to turn it into a rolling work of art. 

  

2.Upgrades for Survival 

Customization isn't just about aesthetics; it's about survival. Explore how you can boost your van's speed with powerful engine upgrades or reinforce it to tackle challenging off-road adventures. Your choices not only enhance style but also dictate your ability to navigate diverse terrains. 

  

3.Crafting Your Mobile Haven 

Transform your van into a cozy home on wheels with personalized interiors. From functional kitchenettes to comfortable sleeping nooks or mobile workspaces, the possibilities are endless. Your van is not just a means of transportation; it's a versatile living space that adapts to your lifestyle. 

  

4.Your Ideas, Our Fuel 

The journey is just beginning, and your ideas are at the heart of our innovation. In this article, "Your Ideas, Our Fuel," we invite you to share your dream customizations. Together, we are shaping the ultimate van life experience. Stay tuned for updates, as your creativity drives the road ahead! 🌟
